name: Zero Day Works II
description: Zero Day Works II: Sean's Zero Day factory floor from the Factory Lab (2026-11-25), every machine, roller run, pad, store, refiner, rover dock and genset where his layout puts them, on Works Floor Slabs with no walls or roof. The main Building Station in the middle, the wide and narrow lines either side, materials north and south. Set it on flat ground on a planet.
